How to automatically dim your screen on Linux

I highly recommend redshift. After you install it, set the command to run at startup and enjoy. I force it to stay pretty dim most of the time instead of ramping up and down very much. Here's the command I run:

redshift -l LAT:LONG -t 4000:3700 -g 0.8 -m vidmode

after throwing in your lat and long, I believe the "-t" forces it to use the stated range for color temp when going between daytime and night time. I like it around 4000K, down from my machine's default of 6400K.
